waveform.constraints: Nonempty finite mono waveform; caller decodes and resamples. This contract uses the full-track raw-waveform path, with default distilled_type=mean.

block_embeddings.pooling: Mean of final CLS and distillation tokens per block.

scores.activation_and_pooling: sigmoid(logits), then arithmetic mean over blocks
scores.semantics: Independent multilabel activations; do not sum to one.

labels.selection: 400-class models use discogs_400labels; 519-class models use discogs_519labels, selected by native num_classes.

settings.initialization: Initialize the mel spectrogram, then move model and waveform to the same device.

preprocessing_and_segmentation.native_frontend: 96-bin mel spectrogram over the full waveform.
preprocessing_and_segmentation.long_audio: Keep floor(mel_frames / 1875) complete contiguous blocks; drop incomplete tail.
preprocessing_and_segmentation.short_audio: One variable-length block without padding; very short waveforms can fail STFT or patch extraction.

adapter.embedding_pooling: Mean native block embeddings, then final L2 normalization.
adapter.genre_selection: Apply top-k after native sigmoid and mean over blocks; capture block embeddings from the same native pass.
